chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Ibrahim died when he was eighteen months old, so Allah completed his breastfeeding in Paradise.

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمُ: Ibrāhīm, the son of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the place where this completion occurred
key_terms.ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ: eighteen; the number of months of his age
key_terms.رَضَاعَهُ: his breastfeeding; the nursing period of the child
key_terms.شَهْرًا: months; indicating his young age at death
key_terms.فَأَتَمَّ: so He completed; indicating Allah's completion of what was unfinished
key_terms.مَاتَ: died; refers to the death of Ibrāhīm in infancy

ai.seo_question: What happened to Ibrāhīm, the infant son of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, after he died?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام states that Ibrāhīm died at the age of eighteen months. The hadith affirms divine mercy toward a child who passed away young, declaring that Allah completed his breastfeeding in Paradise.
